newsitem.title: GERMANY: German sugar beet forecast raised to 25.96 mln T.
newsitem.headline: German sugar beet forecast raised to 25.96 mln T.

text.p: German sugar industry association WVZ in its 12th beet campaign report raised the forecast for final beet deliveries in 1996/97 to 25.96 million tonnes after forecasting 25.80 million up to last week.
Some 26.05 million tonnes were delivered in 1995/96.
A WVZ source noted that harvesting in Lower Saxony and Bavaria, the leading producers, as well as in other regions had risen more strongly than expected in the week under review.
The campaign report put beet deliveries to refineries as of Dec 13 at 25.50 million versus 25.58 million a year earlier.
Average sugar content on Dec 13 at 18.17 percent was up from 16.74 percent a year earlier.
Sugar beet deliveries to refineries as of Dec 6 were 24.03 million tonnes, down from 24.32 million a year earlier.
WVZ will not run delivery updates over the next two weeks because only two factories will be working over the Christmas/New Year holiday period.
The next report is due in the week Jan 6-10.
